Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NO Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: AT STORES ( ASP) 3. SPECIFICATION A) Design : Black color, design-b (ankle boot) as per IS 15298-11 with jug loop and padded collar for comfort. B) Upper Leather : Printed buff leather, chrome tanned, thickness 1.6 to 2.0 mm, black color. height of the upper shall be as per table-4 of IS 15298 (Part-2, 5.2.1). C) Insole : 2.5 mm with leather / cellulose board and should be comfortable to the user. D) Toe Protection : Steel toe cap as per IS 15298 and impact resistance shall be 200 J ± 4J. E) Tongue & Eyelets : The tongue shall be of bellow type and D-rings. Eyelets: 16 nos/pair, copper / steel - rust proof. F) Lace & Thread : Nylon G) Sole : i. Specially blended Nitrile rubber sole with Cleats which are open to sideways, cleat height of the sole thickness sh all be minimum 2.5mm ii.. Sole thickness: Fore part 12.0 mm (min), waist: 9.0 mm (min) & heel: 30.0 mm (min ). iii. Acid and alkali resistant, abrasion resistant, water & oil resistant, anti- skid design, shall be in accordance with IS- 15298. IV. Heat resistant - 300 deg c for 1min. V. Electrical resistance- not less than 15 KV. VI. The height of upper shall correspond to that of design - b (table-4) as per IS-15298 . H) Bond Strength, Material and Length : i) The bond strength of upper to outsole shall be minimum 4n/ mm. ii) Vamp, Collar, Heel Lining and Tongue shall be of leather iii)Overall shoe length with corresponding size shall be as per IS 1638-1969 . I) Marking : Each shoe to be embossed/printed with brand name, size number, month & year of manufacture, 'SAIL / ASP". J) Each batch shall be supplied with : i) Manufacturers' test certificate for complete shoe as per IS 15298 (part-2). Each lot (irrespective of different sizes shall be supplied with lot test certificate indicating all test results as mentioned above conforming to IS 15298 (part 2) requirements for complete shoe issued by footwear Central Institute of design & Development Institute (FDDI) or F'etrochemicals Engineering & Technology (CIPET) or any government shoe testing laboratory. ii) The unique batch number for each lot (irrespective of different sizes) should appear in the test certificate in case there is same batch number for different sizes, then test certificates for each size required from the above mention

ed lab or any certificate for any one size to be submitted. iii) Guarantee/warranty certificates shall be provided with the supply. However, Alloy Steels Plant reserves the right to do independent testing of supplied material as per specification from each batch at random through FDDI or CIPE T or any government shoe testing laboratory. iv) Valid BIS license of manufacturer. K) Packing : Each pair shall be packed separately in poly bag & individual box. L) Guarantee : Shoe must be guaranteed for one year from date of acceptance at our site against any manufacturi ng defects and shall be replaced immediately free of cost during the guarantee period. M) Others Requirements : I. Any other mandatory requirement prevailing at the time of procurement may also be included. . II. Presently IS 15298 is of 2016 version, however supplier to ensure the compliance of latest version if any Special Instruction : 1)All the required documents/certificates as per the attached annexure should be submitted during tender submission. 2) Sample approval is mandatory before bulk supply. 3) The shoe sizes & quantities should be as per annexure. A) Risk Purchase : If the Supplier fails to deliver the stores either in full or in part, within the prescribed d elivery period, the Purchaser shall be entitled at his option to take alternate procurement action, at the risk & cost of the supplier for the unsupplied portion of the goods /items for which delivery has expired without cancelling the contract in respect of the stores not yet due for delivery, or to cancel the contract based on progress of work, including stores not due for delivery, and, if thought fit/necessary, to purchase the stores at the risk and cost of the Supplier. The price differential in case of higher cost to SAIL, if any, shall have to be borne by the defaulting supplier. Moreover, the defaulting supplier shall have no claim over the quantity, which they failed to supply. B) Declaration from Bidders: i) Bid Security Declaration (Annexure-1) ii) Model Clause (Annexure-2) iii) non-collusive Tendering Certificate ( Annexure -5) iv) Anti-Bribery Undertaking (Annexure-6) Declaration as per format enclosed as annexures (ATC Document) and technical Data sheet of t he offered products required to be submitted along-with Techno-Commercial offer. . 4.
